updateContent.title: EhViewer Desktop 0.1.0
content: Initial desktop control-plane release with remote hosts, desktop updater, V2 analytics, and proxy-node peer-cache runtime services.
Desktop Settings now exposes cache inventory, remote-hosts freshness, updater state, analytics queue, and proxy-node diagnostics.
A packaged desktop artifact is not published yet; this metadata endpoint establishes the desktop channel and can be updated once installers are available.

notice.title: EhViewer Desktop 0.1.0
notice.body: Desktop metadata channel initialized for runtime governance and future release rollout.
